title: Playboy Magazine May 1988 Don King Interview Teri Garr Denise Crosby Helmut
conditionDescription: Cover shows light wear and a small pen mark near the barcode. Centerfold not separately verified.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, May 1988 issue. Cover price $4.00.

Features:
- Hair-Raising Interview with Don King
- Denise Crosby Out of Uniform
- Bawdy Talk with Teri Garr
- The Fitness Myth
- Plus Hunter S. Thompson, Helmut Newton, George V. Higgins

Eyes-and-lips cover. The back cover carries a 1988 Chivas Regal ad.

Condition: pre-owned with normal signs of age and storage. Cover shows light wear and a small pen mark near the barcode. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
